cases.question: The archival metric description dates Chernenko's birth 18 September Julian/1 October Gregorian 1912; Soviet biographical tradition uses 11/24 September 1911. Compare the original metric manuscript and other contemporaneous evidence before treating either date as independently verified; preserve both previously saved canonical facts.
